train_transforms:
Compose(
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    ColorJitter(brightness=(0.9, 1.1), contrast=(0.9, 1.1), saturation=None, hue=None)
    SpineResizePad(size=640, interpolation=BILINEAR, fill=(0,0,0), crop=False)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
)
val_transforms:
Compose(
    SpineResizePad(size=640, interpolation=BILINEAR, fill=(0,0,0), crop=False)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
)
selection: Maximum internal validation top-1; earliest epoch on ties.
restart_policy: Exact epoch-boundary states saved; identical package/GPU environment required.
